name: mordred-fated-luminary-normal-levelup-into-luminary-draws-nothing
notes: Mordred, Fated Luminary (KqBosnU7pU): "Mordred can level up into champions of the same base level. When he does, draw two cards." -- the cards are drawn only when Mordred uses that same base level level-up. FIXED (was: an ordinary level 2 -> level 3 level-up of Mordred, Flawless Blade INTO Fated Luminary drew two cards too; this fixture used to be mordred-fated-luminary-normal-levelup-into-luminary-draws-two and pinned the buggy hand size 10). Root cause: DoMaterialize() (Custom/MaterializeLogic.php, the 'Tristan, Shadowreaver (4upufooz13) ... when she levels up, draw 2' block) drew two cards after EVERY champion level-up whose resulting lineage contained Fated Luminary (ChampionHasInLineage(KqBosnU7pU)), without checking that the level-up was a same base level one. Fix: DoMaterialize() records whether the old and new champion have the same base level ($sameBaseLevelLevelUp) and the lineage draw-2 requires it. The hand is 8 = 7 + 1 turn draw (the genuine same-level fixture, Luminary -> Regent, still draws two). The same block also served Tristan, Shadowreaver (identical 'same base level' text), so it is fixed for her too.

rulesClauses: When Mordred levels up into a champion of the SAME base level, draw two cards (an ordinary level 2 -> 3 level-up into Fated Luminary is not that).

engineBug.summary: FIXED. An ordinary level 2 -> level 3 level-up of Mordred, Flawless Blade INTO Fated Luminary drew two cards. DoMaterialize() (Custom/MaterializeLogic.php) drew two after EVERY champion level-up whose resulting lineage contained Fated Luminary (or Tristan, Shadowreaver), without checking that the level-up was a same-base-level one. Fix: compute $sameBaseLevelLevelUp (old champion's base level == new champion's base level) before the lineage is rebuilt and require it for the draw-2.
engineBug.affectedFunction: Custom/MaterializeLogic.php DoMaterialize(): draw-2 block keyed on ChampionHasInLineage('KqBosnU7pU'/'4upufooz13')
